templates.source: https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2025/09/51030/mt-ipcam-comelit-cctv-en-6ed.pdf — Comelit "Comelit CCTV IP Cameras" user manual (6th ed.), section 3.6.7 RTSP (p.56): Config > Network > RTSP shows the unicast address "rtsp://IP or domain name:port/profile1" (main stream), port default 554; multicast form rtsp://IP address:rtsp port/profile1?transportmode=mcast. Same paths in the Advance series manual (https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2020/02/23963/mt-ipcam-advance-en-1ed.pdf, section 3.5.7) and the Advance PTZ manual (https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2022/05/31271/mt-ptz-advance-en-1ed.pdf, section 4.6.7).

https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2025/09/51030/mt-ipcam-comelit-cctv-en-6ed.pdf — Comelit "Comelit CCTV IP Cameras" user manual (6th ed.), section 3.6.7 RTSP (p.56): Config > Network > RTSP shows the unicast address "rtsp://IP or domain name:port/profile2" (sub stream), port default 554; multicast form rtsp://IP address:rtsp port/profile2?transportmode=mcast. Same paths in the Advance series manual (https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2020/02/23963/mt-ipcam-advance-en-1ed.pdf, section 3.5.7) and the Advance PTZ manual (https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2022/05/31271/mt-ptz-advance-en-1ed.pdf, section 4.6.7).

https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2025/09/51030/mt-ipcam-comelit-cctv-en-6ed.pdf — Comelit "Comelit CCTV IP Cameras" user manual (6th ed.), section 3.6.7 RTSP (p.56): Config > Network > RTSP shows the unicast address "rtsp://IP or domain name:port/profile3" (third stream), port default 554; multicast form rtsp://IP address:rtsp port/profile3?transportmode=mcast. Same paths in the Advance series manual (https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2020/02/23963/mt-ipcam-advance-en-1ed.pdf, section 3.5.7) and the Advance PTZ manual (https://staticpro.comelitgroup.com/storage/2022/05/31271/mt-ptz-advance-en-1ed.pdf, section 4.6.7).

notes: Applies to the Comelit Advance, Next and current "Comelit CCTV" IP camera lines (IPBCAMA/IPTCAMA/IPKCAMA/IPBCAMN/IPTCAMN, IPPTZA PTZ, IPLPRA, IPSCAMA, WIBCAMA/WICAMA/WB/WC Wi-Fi, and the IB/IT/IK/IP/IBM/ITM/MIB/MIT/MIK codes): Comelit's own manuals for these lines all document rtsp://<ip>:554/profile1 (main), /profile2 (sub), /profile3 (third); RTSP is enabled under Config > Network > RTSP and requires the camera user/password unless anonymous login is allowed. Codec is whatever each stream is configured for (H.264/H.265/MJPEG). Thermal models add /profile4 for the thermal channel (IPTHBCAMA05F01A manual, section 5.6.5); fisheye models IPFCAMA06FA/IPFCAMA12FA list /profile1 to /profile11 (fisheye, panoramic and PTZ view channels). NOT covered by this guide: the Smart series (IPBCAMS/IPDCAMS/IPSCAMS/WIBCAMS) uses rtsp://<ip>:554/0 (main) and /1 (sub) per the Smart series user manuals and carries its own URL on each camera record; the legacy Easy series manual gives /ch0_0.264 and /ch0_1.264; no official RTSP path was found for the LPRCAM number-plate cameras or for the Smart Wi-Fi kit cameras WIBCAMS02FASP/WIBCAMS02FBSP/WIBCAMS05FASP.
